violation_type.title: Discipline - Appropriate for the Incident (26 TAC §744.2103(a)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver used corporal punishment as a method of discipline. The method used by the caregiver was not geared towards teaching the child acceptable behavior and not appropriate for the incident.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver used corporal punishment as a method of discipline. The method used by the caregiver was not geared towards teaching the child acceptable behavior and not appropriate for the incident.

Based on information obtained during the investigation a caregiver did not follow proper discipline procedures when they removed a child from a table when the child was not following directions during an activity.
